resources.string: I\'m a small companion that lives on this phone. I chat with you using an AI model that runs right here: no internet, no account, and nothing is sent anywhere. Our chats are stored only on this phone.
To think, I need the model file %1$s (about 585 MB). Copy it to the phone, then choose it here. It is checked before use and never leaves the phone.
That file didn\'t work. Choose %1$s, or skip for now.
Model: Gemma 3 1B — Gemma Terms of Use
If you turn on floating Bibi, I show a small notification so you can hide me or turn me off anytime. Android asks you to allow notifications for that. Saying no is fine: chat still works.
